editor_note: The two rewritten entries are faithful and use 해요체: "Primitives" is rendered 프리미티브, and entry 10 keeps the defaults correct (Qiskit uses 리틀 엔디언, BitArray defaults to `big`(엔디언)) and keeps the direction of the example (Sampler/Estimator return 빅 엔디언 results, Executor returns 리틀 엔디언 results).

The seven rewritten headings are faithful, natural noun-style Korean headings and match the body prose: Monitor/calibrate/benchmark become 모니터링, 캘리브레이션, 벤치마킹, and "Monitor holistically" becomes 전체적으로 모니터링하기, which echoes 전체적으로 in entry 14.

None of the 7 rewritten entries (5-11) would mislead a learner. All the facts survive: PEC, PEA, TREX and gate-folding ZNE plus 사후 선택 for non-Markovian errors in [8], 페르미온-Qubit 인코딩 in [10], and the 1차원 및 2차원 Fermi-Hubbard guide in [11]. The problems are punctuation. In [11] the English colon before the guide link became a full stop, so the guide title is left as a sentence fragment after "다음 가이드에서 확인해 보세요." In [6] the colon that introduces the list of tools also became a full stop, so the sentence no longer leads into the list below it.

examples.source: ...tutorial and the following guide: [Building constant-depth circuits ...](...).
examples.translation: ...튜토리얼과 다음 가이드에서 확인해 보세요. [1차원 및 2차원 페르미-허바드 모델의 동역학을 시뮬레이션하기 위한 상수 깊이 Circuit 구축](...).

examples.why: With the colon gone, the linked guide title is left as a standalone fragment after a finished sentence. That reads as broken Korean prose.

examples.source: New tools have been built on top of the [directed execution model](...) framework, which was released earlier this year:
examples.translation: 올해 초에 공개된 [directed execution model](...) 프레임워크를 기반으로 새로운 도구가 만들어졌어요.

examples.why: The English colon introduces the list of tools that follows. The Korean closes with a full stop and gives no cue that a list comes next.

editor_note: The six rewritten entries (5-10) say what the English says and follow the 해요체 convention. Product and category names stay in English as house style requires (Qiskit Functions Catalog, Circuit function, Application function), and core terms are correct: 트랜스파일, 동적 디커플링, 측정 오류 완화, 비국소 상호작용. One wording slip in entry 9: "natively" is rendered as 기본적으로, which a reader takes as "by default" or "basically". The English means the constraints are built into the circuit through XY mixers. 자체적으로 or 네이티브로 would say that. Entry 9 also stacks a long string of modifiers before the noun, which reads a little heavy.

examples.source: enforcing one-hot and set-packing constraints natively through XY-mixers instead of penalty terms
examples.translation: 페널티 항 대신 XY 믹서를 통해 원-핫 및 집합 패킹 제약 조건을 기본적으로 적용하여
examples.suggested: 페널티 항 대신 XY 믹서로 원-핫 및 집합 패킹 제약 조건을 회로 자체에서(네이티브로) 강제하여
examples.why: 기본적으로 reads as 'by default' or 'basically'. The English 'natively' means the constraints are enforced inside the circuit by the mixers, not added as penalty terms. The reader can still follow it because the 'instead of penalty terms' contrast is kept.

editor_note: Entry 5 is faithful and natural 해요체: both migration cases are kept ("새로운 클라이언트 측 Sampler와 Estimator로 마이그레이션하든 … V1 프리미티브를 사용하는 이전 노트북을 마이그레이션하든"), "official, IBM-verified" is rendered as "IBM이 검증한 공식", and the future-skills promise has the same strength as the English.

Entry 129 is faithful: the means clause ("클라이언트 측에서 설계 의도를 포착하는 요소를 제공하고 … 서버 측으로 옮김으로써") still serves "성능을 희생하지 않으면서 … 미세 조정", the Samplomatic layer and Pauli-twirling/noise-injection example still matches its setup, Executor primitive and Qiskit Runtime stay English, and the 합니다 endings match the rest of the page.

I checked all nine rewritten entries (4–12) against the English. None of them would mislead a learner. They keep 해요체 throughout, and the terms are right: 확률적 오류 상쇄(PEC), 측정 기반 사후 선택, 비마르코프 오류, 클라이언트 측 구현. The one slip is in entry 6, where 'provides full transparency and control' became '투명하게 파악하고 세밀하게 조정할 수 있어요'. That drops 'full' (완전한), so the claim comes out a little weaker than the English, though the meaning is still correct.

examples.source: which provides full transparency and control to fine-tune your error mitigation workflow
examples.translation: 이 모델을 사용하면 오류 완화 워크플로를 투명하게 파악하고 세밀하게 조정할 수 있어요.
examples.suggested: 이 모델은 오류 완화 워크플로를 세밀하게 조정할 수 있도록 완전한 투명성과 제어권을 제공해요.
examples.why: The translation leaves out 'full', which makes the claim weaker. Entry 12 does keep it ('완전히 제어할 수 있어요'), so the two entries describing the same model don't match.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The Heron conditional vs Nighthawk r2 unconditional reset caveat [12], the decoherence trade-off of slower cz gates [21] and the DC/AC TLS bias recommendations [23]-[26] all match the source. Three things a native editor would change: (1) "instruction signature" is rendered as 서명 [5][9][15], which reads as a cryptographic or written signature, while Korean programming docs use 시그니처. (2) "noise" is 노이즈 everywhere except 영잡음 외삽법 for ZNE [26]. (3) The Processor family cell "All" stays in English in the tables [11][26] instead of 전체.

examples.source: Instructions with different signatures
examples.translation: 서명이 다른 명령
examples.suggested: 시그니처가 다른 명령
examples.why: In Korean programming usage, an API or instruction signature is 시그니처. 서명 suggests a digital or handwritten signature.

examples.suggested: | 없음 (기본 캘리브레이션) | 전체 | DC (Heron) |

editor_note: Entry 24 is accurate overall. The links (가이드, API 참조, GitHub 저장소) and the 해요체 register (방문하세요, 신고해 주세요) are correct. The only problem is the second sentence: it drops "Feel free to", so an open invitation ("you're welcome to send feedback") becomes a plain request ("submit feedback and report bugs"). This won't mislead a learner, but a native editor would restore the invitational tone with 언제든지 or 자유롭게.

examples.source: Feel free to submit feedback and report bugs in its [GitHub](https://github.com/Qiskit/samplomatic) repository.
examples.translation: [GitHub](https://github.com/Qiskit/samplomatic) 저장소에서 피드백을 제출하고 버그를 신고해 주세요.

examples.why: The translation drops 'Feel free to', which turns an open invitation into a request. The meaning is unchanged, but the friendly tone of the English is lost.

editor_note: None of the 10 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The bullet lists are faithful: Estimator-only conditions are kept ("IBM Quantum Estimator를 사용하는 경우"), and entry 42 keeps the rule that PEA needs ZNE as well, with `pea` as the amplifier of `zne_mitigation`. They all use the house 해요체 register. The one thing to fix is in entry 19, which writes "Pauli 트월링" twice, while the heading [12] and body text [14], [15], [17] use "파울리 트월링" / "파울리 Gate". It should become "파울리" to match the rest of the page.

examples.source: You can enable Pauli twirling the following ways: - A [Pauli twirling custom pass](/guides/custom-transpiler-pass) in Qiskit
examples.translation: 다음과 같은 방법으로 Pauli 트월링을 활성화할 수 있어요. - Qiskit의 [Pauli 트월링 사용자 정의 패스]

examples.why: The rest of the page (heading [12], [14], [15], [17]) consistently uses 파울리 트월링. The mixed Latin/Hangul spelling in the rewritten entry is a within-file inconsistency.

editor_note: All 22 rewritten entries are faithful and in 해요체: the 'Must also enable ZNE' caveat is kept as '(ZNE도 함께 활성화해야 함)', entry 49 keeps the v0.50.0 client-side Estimator condition with '별도의 노이즈 학습 작업이 필요해요', and the technique titles ('동적 디커플링', 'Pauli 트월링') match the page's '트월링' convention.

Entry 43 keeps the English meaning: "latest version" is 최신 버전, "older option versions" is 이전 옵션 버전 and "select a previous version" is 이전 버전을 선택하세요, and "API 참조" matches its use in entry 6. Its 합니다 ending matches the surrounding entries (0, 6, 10), which mix 합니다 and 해요 across the page, so it is not a slip specific to this entry.

Entry 54 matches the English item for item: "권장 사항", "[브로드캐스팅] 개요를 검토해 보세요" and "오류 완화 기술을 결합하는 방법" are faithful, the register is consistent 해요체, and keeping "directed execution model" and the tutorial title in English is a defensible choice for a feature name.

The four rewritten entries (32, 34, 35, 36) keep the meaning of the English and would not mislead a learner. The shapes (28, 10, 1024, 3) and (28, 10, 1, 3), little-endian order, "index 0 = classical bit 0 = 최하위 비트" and the one-shot reason for the bit-flip array are all intact, and the register is 해요체 as required. One wording issue: in entries 32 and 36, "runs over" is calqued as "고전 비트를 … 따라가요" ("follows the classical bits"). That is stiff, and a Korean technical writer would more naturally say the axis corresponds to the classical bits, arranged in little-endian order. The "도" ("also") added in entry 36 is harmless, because it points back to entry 32.

examples.source: The right-most axis of `result_0` runs over classical bits in little-endian order.
examples.translation: `result_0`의 가장 오른쪽 축은 고전 비트를 리틀 엔디언 순서로 따라가요.
examples.suggested: `result_0`의 가장 오른쪽 축은 고전 비트에 해당하며, 리틀 엔디언 순서로 배열돼요.
examples.why: This calques "runs over": an array axis does not "follow" (따라가다) the bits. Saying it corresponds to them is the idiomatic Korean way to describe what an array axis indexes.

examples.source: Note that the right-most axis of `result_1` runs over classical bits in little-endian order.
examples.translation: `result_1`의 가장 오른쪽 축도 고전 비트를 리틀 엔디언 순서로 따라간다는 점에 유의하세요.
examples.suggested: `result_1`의 가장 오른쪽 축도 고전 비트에 해당하며 리틀 엔디언 순서로 배열된다는 점에 유의하세요.
examples.why: This is the same calque of "runs over" as in entry 32, so the suggested wording should match the fix there.

editor_note: Entry 11 is accurate and reads naturally. "Executor는 samplex에 인코딩된 정보만 처리할 수 있습니다" keeps the English "only" restriction, and "제한 사항을 이해하려면 [Samplomatic 가이드]를 참조하세요" is correct 해요체 and keeps samplex the same as in entry 6.

Entries 12 and 15 keep the meaning of the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The HI-VQE "respectively, by orders of magnitude" comparison and the TEM/QESEM claims about beating ZNE and PEC are accurate. A native editor would still fix three small slips. In Aqarios, "natively" became 기본적으로, which reads as "by default"; it should say the solver applies the constraints directly. The Orbit cell uses 워크플로 while the rest of the page uses 워크플로우, and 트랜스파일 (entries 12 and 15) does not match 트랜스파일링 in entry 7. In the Parity Twine cell, "enabling" now attaches to the workload ("…워크로드로, …가능하게 해요"), when in the English it is the reduced gate count and depth that make larger problems possible.

examples.source: enforcing one-hot and set-packing constraints natively through XY-mixers instead of penalty terms
examples.translation: 페널티 항 대신 XY 믹서를 통해 원-핫 및 집합 패킹 제약 조건을 기본적으로 적용하여
examples.suggested: 페널티 항 대신 XY 믹서로 원-핫 및 집합 패킹 제약 조건을 직접(네이티브하게) 적용하여
examples.why: 기본적으로 reads as 'by default' or 'basically', not 'natively' (built into the mixer).

examples.why: The translation makes the workload the thing that enables larger problems. In the English, the reduced gate count and depth do the enabling. This is a slight attachment shift that does not mislead.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and natural 해요체: [25] keeps the "structurally equivalent" claim and the replacement of single-qubit gates by parameterized gates ("단일 qubit Gate가 매개변수화된 Gate로 대체돼요"), with the twirling example in its parenthesis, and [27] correctly points to the Samplomatic API docs for `samplomatic.samplex.Samplex` and its arguments.

All 18 rewritten entries keep the English meaning. The DR responsibilities split (IBM vs. user), the "switch region (권장)" vs. "wait for recovery" options and both caveats in 24/25 (qubit characteristics, data residency) are intact. The problem is register. Entries 14, 16, 20, 22, 23 and 27 use 해요체 (다뤄요, 책임져요, 권장해요), but 10, 17 and 18 use 하십시오체 (사용할 수 있습니다:, 재구축합니다, 되돌립니다), so the DR section switches style partway through. Separately, "재해 복구 이벤트" in 29 is a calque of "event"; "재해 복구 상황" reads more naturally.

editor_note: All 13 rewritten entries say what the English says. That includes the v0.50.0 client-side Sampler/Estimator change, the old behaviour where everything except `shots` was ignored, the roughly 32-qubit laptop limit and the three ways to keep testing manageable. Two minor problems remain. 'Primitive' is translated two ways in these entries: 프리미티브 in entries 8, 24 and 41, but 기본 요소 in entry 9 (the older entries 36 and 48 also use 기본 요소). editor_note: Entry 64 is faithful. Both verification routes are kept: the `Operator` 유니터리 구현 comparison, with its "측정 트월링을 취소하는 … 보정을 고려한 후" caveat attached, and the 기댓값 comparison from a local `StatevectorSampler`/`StatevectorEstimator` run. Both rewritten entries are faithful. Entry 46's table keeps every category and annotation (단일 큐비트 게이트, 2큐비트 게이트, 분수 게이트, 비유니터리 명령, 제어 흐름 with 고전적 피드포워드), and entry 65 correctly explains that Target holds the information needed for transpilation, including 명령 오류와 지속 시간, and that the cell reads the properties of a cz gate on 연결된 한 쌍의 qubit, in the house 해요체 register.

Entry 18 keeps the English meaning: client-side vs server-side tools, `python` 3.11 이상, the requirements.txt pointer and the custom-infrastructure guide are all there, so it does not mislead. The problem is the sentence endings. They switch from 합니다체 ("제공합니다") to 해요체 ("필요해요") and then to a softened "참고해 주세요" within one paragraph. A native editor would make them consistent. Since this page mostly uses 합니다, the simplest fix is "필요합니다" and "참고하세요".

examples.source: These packages require `python` 3.11+. ... follow the [Cloud infrastructure setup] guide.
examples.translation: 이 패키지를 사용하려면 `python` 3.11 이상이 필요해요. ... 가이드를 참고해 주세요.
examples.suggested: 이 패키지를 사용하려면 `python` 3.11 이상이 필요합니다. ... 가이드를 참고하세요.
examples.why: The paragraph mixes 합니다체 (제공합니다), 해요체 (필요해요) and a polite request (참고해 주세요). The endings should be unified, which is a stylistic fix only; the meaning is correct.

editor_note: Entry 26 is faithful and natural: it keeps every link and item ([행동 강령], the 개인/기업 기여자 PDF license agreements, [버전 전략], and the 기여자/유지관리자 guides) and ends in the house 해요체 with "포함되어 있어요".

None of the six rewritten entries would mislead a learner. "No install, no account needed to start", "only if you want real quantum hardware" (실제 양자 하드웨어를 사용하고 싶을 때만) and "On by default" all keep their meaning, and 강좌 카탈로그 둘러보기 and 소개 및 크레딧 are good choices. The issues are register only: entries 5, 13 and 17 use the formal -습니다 ending (시작할 수 있습니다, 필요하지 않습니다, 켜져 있습니다) where house style is 해요체, which this page already uses in entries 45 and 50. Separately, the card description in entry 14 drops an object particle ("Bell 상태 만들고"), which reads clipped.

examples.source: No IBM Quantum account needed. Code runs on a built-in simulator by default.
examples.translation: IBM Quantum 계정이 필요하지 않습니다. 코드는 기본적으로 내장 시뮬레이터에서 실행됩니다.
examples.suggested: IBM Quantum 계정이 필요 없어요. 코드는 기본적으로 내장 시뮬레이터에서 실행돼요.
examples.why: Formal -습니다 ending where house style is 해요체. Entries 5 and 17 have the same slip.

examples.source: doQumentation's own intro — build a Bell state, run it three ways
examples.translation: doQumentation의 자체 입문 — Bell 상태 만들고 세 가지 방법으로 실행하기
examples.suggested: doQumentation의 자체 입문 — Bell 상태를 만들고 세 가지 방법으로 실행하기
examples.why: The missing object particle 를 makes the phrase read clipped. The other card descriptions keep their particles.

editor_note: Entry 42 says what the English says, and its terms match the rest of the file: 페르미온(생성 및 소멸) 연산자 (fermionic creation and annihilation operators), 교환 시 반대칭 (antisymmetry under exchange), 구별 가능한 입자나 보손 시스템 (distinguishable or bosonic system), and "에르미트이면서 동시에 유니타리" (both Hermitian and unitary) as the reason Pauli operators are used.

The meaning holds throughout. I checked conditions, quantities, caveats and the worked examples (A=0.6 → 5,000 and ≈8,334 raw shots, the [[4,2,2]] syndrome table, the CNOT/CZ propagation rules, the gamma and PEC cost statements), and none of them would mislead a learner. The register breaks house style: entries [5]–[29] use 해요체, but from [30] to the end the page switches to 하십시오체/합니다체 (…기법입니다, …거부합니다). Core terms are also split across sections: the commuting relation is 가환 in [75]/[81]/[100] but 교환 in [137]/[170]/[190]; stabilizer generators are 생성자 in [75], 생성원 in [28]/[129] and 생성기 in [223]/[261]; ancilla is 보조 큐비트, 앤실라 or raw "ancilla"; acceptance and false-accept come out as 수용/승인/수락 and 거짓 수용/오수락; check is 검사 except 체크 in [223]/[300]; Part is 1부, 파트 1 or Part 2; ansatz is 앤저츠 or 앤자츠. One small softening: in [139], "equally close" became 거의 같은 ("almost equally close").

examples.source: Parity checking is a classical error-detection technique.
examples.translation: 패리티 검사(parity checking)는 고전적인 오류 검출 기법입니다.
examples.suggested: 패리티 검사는 고전적인 오류 검출 기법이에요.
examples.why: From here to the end of the page the register switches from the house 해요체 (used in [5]–[29]) to 합니다체. The page therefore reads as two separately translated halves.

examples.source: weight-2 Pauli operators ... can commute with both stabilizers
examples.translation: 가중치 $2$의 Pauli 연산자가 두 스태빌라이저와 모두 교환하여
examples.suggested: …두 스태빌라이저와 모두 가환하여
examples.why: The commuting relation is 가환/반가환 in [75], [81], [83] and [100], but 교환/반교환 here and throughout Part 2. Pick one pair and use it everywhere.

examples.source: Coherent Pauli checks (Sections 2.2-2.3) provided the algebraic foundation
examples.translation: 코히런트 Pauli 체크([2.2]-[2.3]절)는 대수적 토대를 제공했습니다.
examples.suggested: 코히어런트 Pauli 검사([2.2]-[2.3]절)는 대수적 토대를 제공했습니다.
examples.why: Elsewhere the page uses 검사 and 코히어런트, and in [308] it keeps English 'Coherent'. Here 체크 and 코히런트 appear, alongside raw ancilla, stabilizer and post-selection, so the summary does not match the body's terms.

examples.source: multiple ideal codewords often equally close in bitstring distance
examples.translation: 비트열 거리가 거의 같은 이상적 코드워드가 여러 개 있는 경우가 많음
examples.suggested: 비트열 거리가 똑같이 가까운 이상적 코드워드가 여러 개 있는 경우가 많음
examples.why: 'Equally close' (an exact tie, which is what makes the case ambiguous) has been softened to 'almost equal'. The table header also says 오수락, while [124] uses 거짓 수용.

examples.source: Stabilizer generators.
examples.translation: 스태빌라이저 생성자.
examples.suggested: 스태빌라이저 생성원.
examples.why: The same term appears as 생성원 in [28], [129] and [131] and as 생성기 in [223]/[261]. One concept with three Korean names makes the glossary hard to follow.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The M3, TREX, ZNE and PEC explanations, the worked TREX and PEC numbers, and the caveats (TREX only removes readout bias, PEC and ZNE do not combine, the 30-qubit PEC result was worse than unmitigated) all come through intact. The defects are surface ones. 'transpile' is garbled to '트랜spile' twice ([124], [427]), and a stray English 'time' sits in '이상적인 time 발전' ([213]). Terms also switch partway through the file: noise is '잡음' up to about [141] and '노이즈' from [119]/[144] on, ZNE is both '영잡음 외삽' and '영 잡음 외삽법', lesson is both '레슨' and '수업', and Pauli twirling appears as '파울리 트월링', 'Pauli twirling' and 'Pauli-twirled 노이즈'. The register is 합니다체 throughout rather than the house 해요체, with humble slips like '보여 드리겠습니다' and '다시 말씀드립니다'.

examples.source: Transpile the circuit using a pass manager.
examples.translation: 패스 매니저를 사용해 회로를 트랜spile합니다.
examples.suggested: 패스 매니저를 사용해 회로를 트랜스파일합니다.
examples.why: The word is half Hangul, half Latin. The same corruption is in [427], while every other entry in the file uses '트랜스파일'.

examples.source: On real hardware, this ideal evolution is corrupted by noise.
examples.translation: 실제 하드웨어에서는 이 이상적인 time 발전이 노이즈로 인해 손상됩니다.
examples.suggested: 실제 하드웨어에서는 이 이상적인 시간 발전이 노이즈로 인해 손상됩니다.
examples.why: A stray English word sits in the middle of a Korean sentence. It reads as an unfinished edit.

examples.source: Running a target circuit at multiple "noise levels" — modifications to the circuit...
examples.translation: 대상 회로를 여러 "노이즈 수준"에서 실행합니다. ... 회로를 수정한 것입니다 —
examples.suggested: Use one word for noise throughout ('잡음' or '노이즈'). Also delete the dangling — at the end of the sentence.
examples.why: Noise is '잡음' in the first part of the file ([9]–[141], e.g. '영잡음 외삽') and '노이즈' from here on. The em dash was moved to the end of the sentence, where it serves no purpose.

examples.source: PEC and Pauli twirling are generally compatible and often beneficial.
examples.translation: PEC와 Pauli twirling은 일반적으로 호환되며 종종 도움이 됩니다.
examples.suggested: PEC와 파울리 트월링은 일반적으로 호환되며 종종 도움이 됩니다.
examples.why: Elsewhere the file has '파울리 트월링' ([201], [450]). Here and in [260] and [269] ('Pauli-twirled 노이즈') the term is left in English, so it is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: We restate to be absolutely clear:
examples.translation: 분명히 하기 위해 다시 말씀드립니다.
examples.suggested: 분명히 하기 위해 다시 말해 둡니다.
examples.why: This is a humble form ('말씀드리다'), as are '보여 드리겠습니다' in [22] and '보여 드리기' in [318]. The whole file is in 합니다체 rather than the house 해요체.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and natural, and they match the rest of the page: [6] renders "picturing how they work" as "작동 방식을 그려 보는 데 도움이 되는 유용한 애니메이션", and [7] keeps "오류 억제" consistent with the page and covers the video title's three topics (개요, 작동 방식, 다른 방법과의 관계).
All four rewritten course titles are faithful and natural Korean: "VQE를 활용한 양자 화학", "지금 양자 컴퓨터 활용하기", and "교실에서의 Qiskit - 컴퓨터 과학 / 양자 역학", with VQE and Qiskit kept in English and the links unchanged.
Both rewritten link titles are faithful and natural, keeping Qiskit in English: "교실에서의 Qiskit - 컴퓨터 과학" and "교실에서의 Qiskit - 양자 역학", with link targets unchanged.

The meaning is faithful throughout. The variational-bound logic, the M_J-on-products argument, the angle-magnitude reasoning in [170] and the binding-constraint discussion all match the English, and I found no semantic drift. The problem is terminology: the second part of the file switches to a different set of terms than the first part uses. Parity is 패리티 in [10]–[105] but 홀짝성 in [159] and [173]. 'Repair' is 보정 in [28], [103] and [104] but 복구 in [144], which merges it with configuration 'recovery' (구성 복구). Several other terms also appear in two forms: 부분 공간/부분공간, 고유값/고윳값, 행렬 원소/행렬 요소, 궤도/오비탈 ([143]) and 종류/종 for species. [128] adds English glosses in parentheses (풀(pool), 들뜸(excitation), 한계(bound)) for terms the file had already established, and [164] drops 'oscillator' from 'oscillator frequency'.

examples.source: Parity is automatically satisfied inside a single major shell
examples.translation: 단일 주 껍질 안에서는 홀짝성(parity)이 자동으로 만족되므로
examples.suggested: 단일 주껍질 안에서는 패리티가 자동으로 만족되므로
examples.why: Entries [10]–[105] use 패리티 for parity. Switching to 홀짝성 here, and again in [173], splits the term within the file.

examples.source: Every shot with the wrong proton or neutron number is repaired against the current occupancy estimate
examples.translation: 모든 샷은 폐기되지 않고 현재 점유율 추정에 맞춰 복구되며, 복구된 각 반쪽 구성은
examples.suggested: 모든 샷은 폐기되지 않고 현재 점유율 추정치에 맞춰 보정되며, 보정된 각 절반 구성은
examples.why: Entries [28], [103] and [104] translate 'repair' as 보정. Using 복구 here blurs it with 구성 복구 (configuration recovery), and 반쪽 also differs from the earlier 절반.

examples.source: The pool grows to several hundred allowed excitations ... The bound remains rigorous
examples.translation: 풀(pool)이 수백 개의 허용된 들뜸(excitation)으로 커지므로 ... 이 한계(bound)는 여전히 엄밀하지만
examples.suggested: 풀이 수백 개의 허용된 들뜸으로 커지므로 ... 이 상한은 여전히 엄밀하지만
examples.why: The file established these terms long before this entry, so the English glosses in parentheses are redundant and read stiffly. 'Bound' is 상한 elsewhere.

examples.source: the distance between the orbitals they connect
examples.translation: 연결하는 오비탈 사이의 거리
examples.suggested: 연결하는 궤도 사이의 거리
examples.why: Everywhere else in the file, orbital is 궤도.

examples.source: where an oscillator frequency and a core energy would plausibly go
examples.translation: 진동수와 코어 에너지가 들어갈 법한 자리
examples.suggested: 진동자 진동수(ħω)와 코어 에너지가 들어갈 법한 자리
examples.why: Leaving out 'oscillator' loses the reference to the harmonic-oscillator parameter of the .snt header. This is a dropped qualifier only and does not mislead.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The long caveats are accurate, including the diagonal-filter approximation in [58], the pruning trade-off in [91] and the subspace-cost discussion in [87]–[88], and the file uses 해요체 consistently. Three terms are split within the file. Time evolution is 시간 발전 in [15]/[25]/[62] but 시간 전개 in [69]/[93]/[96]. Transpile appears as 'transpiler 패스', '트랜스파일합니다', 'Transpiler 패스' and 'Transpile할'. Ansatz is 앤사츠 in [15]/[63] but 'ansatz' in [96]. Two smaller slips: 'the set of evolution times' became the vague '시간 전개 값의 집합' in [93], and 'spurious strings' became '불필요한 문자열' ('unnecessary strings') in [90].

examples.source: each term in the group is evolved with its coefficient reduced to its sign
examples.translation: 그룹의 각 항은 계수를 부호만 남긴 값으로 줄여서 시간 전개합니다
examples.suggested: 그룹의 각 항은 계수를 부호만 남긴 값으로 줄여서 시간 발전시킵니다
examples.why: The rest of the file uses 시간 발전 ([15], [25], [60], [62]). [69], [93] and [96] switch to 시간 전개, so pick one rendering.

examples.source: alongside the number of circuits, the set of evolution times, and diagonal-term filtering
examples.translation: 회로 수, 시간 전개 값의 집합, 대각항 필터링과 함께
examples.suggested: 회로 수, 발전 시간의 집합, 대각 항 필터링과 함께
examples.why: '시간 전개 값' is vague: the source means the set of evolution times (`times`), which [60] already rendered as 발전 시간.

examples.source: The qDRIFT transpiler pass does this for us.
examples.translation: qDRIFT Transpiler 패스가 이를 대신 처리해 줍니다.
examples.suggested: qDRIFT 트랜스파일러 패스가 이를 대신 처리해 줍니다.
examples.why: Transpile is rendered four ways across [46], [66], [67], [71], [76] and [77] ('transpiler', '트랜스파일', 'Transpiler', 'Transpile할'). The file should settle on one form.

examples.source: using time-evolution circuits instead of a variational ansatz
examples.translation: 변분 ansatz 대신 시간 전개 회로를 사용하는
examples.suggested: 변분 앤사츠 대신 시간 발전 회로를 사용하는
examples.why: [15] and [63] use 앤사츠, and the rest of the file uses 시간 발전.

examples.source: Pruning of spurious strings
examples.translation: 불필요한 문자열 가지치기
examples.suggested: 잘못된 비트열 가지치기
examples.why: 'Spurious' here means invalid or noise-induced, which is how [91] and [92] describe these bitstrings. '불필요한' means 'unnecessary', which is a different idea.

editor_note: Rewritten entry 18 is faithful: it keeps the condition ("아직 자격 증명을 저장하지 않았다면"), the step-4/5 mapping ("4단계의 API 키로", "5단계의 CRN으로") and the safety caveat ("이 작업을 하기 전에는 셀이 아무것도 저장하지 않으므로… 이전에 저장한 계정을 덮어쓰지 않습니다"), so nothing in it would mislead a learner.

All three rewritten titles are faithful and none would mislead a learner. Entry 23 ("양자 근사 다목적 최적화") matches the style of entry 20's "양자 근사 최적화 알고리즘". In entry 37, "Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger 상태의 섀도 토모그래피" is acceptable. The one thing to fix is in entry 38: "time evolution" is rendered as "시간 발전", but entry 77 on the same page uses "시간 진화" ("시간 진화 Circuit을 위한 근사 양자 컴파일"). Both terms are standard Korean physics usage, so this is a within-file inconsistency only, and one of the two should be made to match the other.

examples.source: Simulate time evolution of the transverse-field Ising model
examples.translation: 횡자기장 이징 모델의 시간 발전 시뮬레이션
examples.suggested: 횡자기장 이징 모델의 시간 진화 시뮬레이션 (or change entry 77 to 시간 발전 Circuit)
examples.why: Entry 77 on the same page renders 'time evolution' as '시간 진화'. Both terms are correct, but the page should use one consistently.

editor_note: I found no semantic drift in the rewritten Fortran section. The variational-bound claim, the per-step vs pooled restriction (209), the job-submission details (213) and the comparison table (220) all match the English. The problems are terminology splits inside this page. Slater determinant is 행렬식 in 181–196 but 결정자 in 204/206/220/221. Pooled is 풀링된 but 통합 in 209/220. Valence is 가전자 (180) vs 원자가 (182/201/214), shell is 셸 vs 껍질, and two-body is 두 몸체/2체/이체. In entry 99, 'hole' is rendered as 공공, which means 'public'; it should be 정공 or 구멍. The register also switches from 해요체 (182–196) to 합니다체 (198–226), and a few phrases are calques, e.g. 182 '품질에 비용을 치르게 할 뿐' and 181 '행렬식들의 생성으로 ... 구축'.

examples.source: only if the particle state has the same $m_j$ as the hole
examples.translation: 입자 상태가 공공과 같은 $m_j$를 가질 때만
examples.suggested: 입자 상태가 정공(구멍)과 같은 $m_j$를 가질 때만
examples.why: 공공 means 'public' and is not the physics term for a hole; the standard rendering is 정공 or 구멍.

examples.source: complete 640-determinant basis
examples.translation: 640개 결정자 전체 기저
examples.suggested: 640개 행렬식으로 이루어진 전체 기저
examples.why: Entries 181–196 call a Slater determinant 행렬식, but 204/206/220/221 switch to the nonstandard 결정자.

examples.source: one pooled subspace ... because pooled mode runs the full circuit ensemble
examples.translation: 하나의 통합 부분공간 ... 통합 모드는 전체 회로 앙상블을 실행하기 때문입니다
examples.suggested: 하나의 풀링된 부분공간 ... pooled 모드는 전체 회로 앙상블을 실행하기 때문입니다
examples.why: The title and 181/193 use 풀링된 for 'pooled'. 통합 breaks the link to the method name and to the `--mode pooled` flag.

examples.source: Noise therefore costs subspace quality, not correctness.
examples.translation: 따라서 노이즈는 부분 공간의 품질에 비용을 치르게 할 뿐, 정확성에는 영향을 주지 않아요.
examples.suggested: 따라서 노이즈는 부분 공간의 품질을 떨어뜨릴 뿐, 결과의 정확성을 해치지는 않아요.
examples.why: '비용을 치르게 하다' is a calque of English 'costs'. The page also mixes 원자가 here with 가전자 in 180 for 'valence'.

examples.source: built and diagonalized classically in the span of those determinants
examples.translation: 이러한 행렬식들의 생성으로 고전적으로 구축되고 대각화됩니다
examples.suggested: 이러한 행렬식들이 생성하는(펼치는) 공간에서 고전적으로 구축되고 대각화됩니다
examples.why: '생성으로' reads as 'by creating' rather than 'in the span'; entry 193 already uses the clearer '펼치는 공간'.

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (18, 65, 71) misleads a learner. The version (v0.47.0), the QuantumProgram/Executor classes, PEC anti-noise placement and the canonical_qubits purpose all match the English. Entry 65 calls the annotated boxes '주석이 달린 박스', but the rest of the page uses '어노테이션' for annotation (`Box` 어노테이션, `InjectNoise` 어노테이션). Entry 71 keeps the English clause order ('…캡처되는 결과로, Executor에 제공할 때 … 수단으로'), so the sentence reads stiff. Entry 18 leaves the link text 'directed execution model' in English, while entry 71 translates its link text ('큐비트 순서 규칙').

examples.source: places the circuit instructions into annotated boxes
examples.translation: 회로 명령어를 주석이 달린 박스에 배치합니다
examples.suggested: 회로 명령어를 어노테이션이 달린 박스에 배치합니다
examples.why: Elsewhere on the page annotation is consistently '어노테이션' (entries 30, 58, 66). '주석' hides the link to the `InjectNoise` annotations discussed right after.

examples.source: we introduce the notion of `canonical_qubits` as a means to appropriately update the qubit ordering when providing it to Executor, as a result of how qubit order is captured when boxing circuits and finding unique instructions
examples.translation: 아래에서는 회로를 박스화하고 고유 명령어를 찾는 방식에 따라 큐비트 순서가 캡처되는 결과로, Executor에 제공할 때 큐비트 순서를 적절히 업데이트하는 수단으로 `canonical_qubits`라는 개념을 소개합니다.
examples.suggested: 회로를 박스화하고 고유 명령어를 찾을 때 큐비트 순서가 기록되는 방식 때문에, Executor에 전달할 때 큐비트 순서를 적절히 갱신해야 합니다. 이를 위해 아래에서 `canonical_qubits`라는 개념을 소개합니다.
examples.why: The sentence copies the English clause order into one long chain of '~결과로 … ~수단으로'. Splitting it into a reason and a purpose reads more naturally in Korean.

examples.source: Read more in the [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model) guide.
examples.translation: 자세한 내용은 [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model) 가이드에서 확인하세요.
examples.suggested: 자세한 내용은 [지정 실행 모델(directed execution model)](/guides/directed-execution-model) 가이드에서 확인하세요.
examples.why: The link text is left in English, while other link texts on this page are translated (e.g. entry 71 '큐비트 순서 규칙'). It is not one of the always-English names. '우리의 워크플로' is also a mild calque; '이 워크플로' would be more natural.

editor_note: Entry 126 is faithful and natural: "canonical form expected by the Executor" is rendered as "`Executor`가 기대하는 표준형", matching heading [124] "측정 기저를 표준형으로 변환", and the Samplomatic docs pointer is kept intact.

The translation is faithful overall, and the key caveats come through: QAOA is about as good as uniform random sampling ([21], [55]), and the 8-asset run is effectively a brute-force check ([43]). The main issue is that '분산' means both 'variance' (risk, [17]) and 'diversification' (the third objective, [0], [8], [19]), and also translates 'diversity term' as '분산 항' ([48]). This blurs the risk objective with the diversification objective, so '다각화' would be the clearer word for diversification. In [46], 'nothing else about the method does [change]' became '방법 자체는 전혀 달라지지 않습니다', which contradicts the list of method changes that follows it. In [40], the 'Because…' that explains why all weight vectors go into a single batched job was dropped.

examples.source: risk (the variance of those returns) ... hurts diversification
examples.translation: 위험(그 수익의 분산) ... 분산 효과가 떨어집니다
examples.suggested: 위험(그 수익의 분산) ... 다각화 효과가 떨어집니다; likewise 위험/수익/다각화 in [0], [8], [19]
examples.why: The same word, 분산, is used for variance (risk) and for diversification (a separate objective), so a learner may think the third objective is just risk again.

examples.source: couple each sector in a light ring for the diversity term
examples.translation: 분산 항을 위해 각 섹터를 가벼운 고리로 결합합니다
examples.suggested: 다각화 항을 위해 각 섹터를 가벼운 고리로 결합합니다
examples.why: Right after a sentence about the covariance/risk model, '분산 항' reads as 'variance term'.

examples.source: Several things change, and **nothing else about the method does**:
examples.translation: 몇 가지가 달라지지만 **방법 자체는 전혀 달라지지 않습니다**.
examples.suggested: 다음 몇 가지만 달라지고, **방법의 나머지는 그대로입니다**.
examples.why: The English says only the listed things change. The Korean says the method does not change at all, which contradicts the list that follows (MPS training, sparsification).

examples.source: Because only the objective weights change between sweeps (not the trained angles), all the weight vectors are submitted in a single batched job.
examples.translation: 훑는 동안 바뀌는 것은 목적 가중치뿐이고(학습된 각도는 바뀌지 않음), 모든 가중치 벡터는 하나의 배치 잡으로 제출됩니다.
examples.suggested: 훑는 동안 바뀌는 것은 목적 가중치뿐이므로(학습된 각도는 그대로), 모든 가중치 벡터를 하나의 배치 잡으로 제출할 수 있습니다.
examples.why: The causal link that explains why batching works was turned into two unrelated facts.

editor_note: Nothing in the translation would mislead a learner. Conditions, quantities and caveats all match the English, including the 3^k vs 4^k bound in [29], the postselection logic in [76]/[83] and the 1/sqrt(T) prefactor claim in [72]. The terminology drifts in the second half, though. 'Shadow tomography' is 섀도 토모그래피 everywhere up to [43], then switches to 섀도 단층 촬영 in [72], [75] and [86]. Pauli changes from 파울리 to Latin 'Pauli' in [75] and [82]. 'Median of means' is 평균의 중앙값 in [41]/[57] but left in English in [67]. Hyphenation also varies (2큐비트 vs 2-큐비트), and 'layout' is both 레이아웃 and 배치. Separately, 'coherence thresholds' in [51] is rendered 일관성 임계값 ('consistency'), when the physics term is 결맞음.

examples.source: The shot scaling of shadow tomography is assessed...
examples.translation: 섀도 단층 촬영의 샷 스케일링을 평가합니다
examples.suggested: 섀도 토모그래피의 샷 스케일링을 평가합니다
examples.why: The term established earlier in the file is 섀도 토모그래피. Here, and again in [75] and [86], it switches to 섀도 단층 촬영.

examples.source: exceed error or coherence thresholds
examples.translation: 오류 또는 일관성 임계값을 초과하는
examples.suggested: 오류 또는 결맞음(coherence) 임계값을 초과하는
examples.why: In quantum computing, coherence (T1/T2) is 결맞음. 일관성 means 'consistency', so the reader loses the link to the T2 times mentioned in [80].

examples.source: local Pauli shadow tomography
examples.translation: 국소 Pauli 섀도 단층 촬영
examples.suggested: 국소 파울리 섀도 토모그래피
examples.why: Earlier entries render Pauli as 파울리. Latin 'Pauli' appears here and in [82].

examples.source: the median-of-means (MOM) estimator
examples.translation: median-of-means(MOM) 추정기
examples.suggested: 평균의 중앙값(median-of-means, MOM) 추정기
examples.why: The term is left in English here, but [41] and [57] translate it as 평균의 중앙값.

editor_note: None of the rewritten entries change the meaning. The numbers and caveats all survive: 1137 of 10000 shots, 49 of 120 determinants, the 0.1373 Ha gap, the statement that the comparison is not controlled, and the note that the Linux recipe is untested. The problems are inconsistent terminology. The Python-tab entries (20, 71) use "Transpiler 패스", "Backend에 맞게" and the awkward "Transpiler로 변환", but the C++ entries (134, 138, 164) use "백엔드" and "트랜스파일". "Evolution/evolved" is "진화" in most entries (126, 129, 136, 164) but "전개" in 75 and 99. "Krylov" stays in English in 166 but becomes "크릴로프" in 175.

examples.source: followed by transpiling our circuit for the backend of choice
examples.translation: 선택한 Backend에 맞게 회로를 Transpiler로 변환합니다
examples.suggested: 선택한 백엔드에 맞게 회로를 트랜스파일합니다
examples.why: Saying 'convert with the Transpiler' is awkward, and the capitalized Backend/Transpiler clash with 백엔드/트랜스파일 in entries 134, 138 and 164.

examples.source: each term in the group is evolved with its coefficient reduced to its sign
examples.translation: 그룹의 각 항은 계수를 부호만 남긴 채 전개됩니다
examples.suggested: 그룹의 각 항은 계수를 부호만 남긴 채 시간 진화됩니다
examples.why: Time evolution is 진화 everywhere else on the page (126, 129, 136, 164). 전개 usually means 'expansion', so this blurs the concept.

examples.source: the set of evolution times
examples.translation: 전개 시간 집합
examples.suggested: 진화 시간 집합
examples.why: The comparison table in entry 164 calls the same parameter 진화 시간.

examples.source: Sample-based Krylov quantum diagonalization
examples.translation: 샘플 기반 크릴로프 양자 대각화
examples.suggested: 샘플 기반 Krylov 양자 대각화
examples.why: Entry 166 keeps 'Krylov' in English, so the page should use one form.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the closing Trotter-step trade-off ([67]: 'outweighs' becomes 상쇄하고도 남기) and the large-scale reference caveat ([64]), so nothing would mislead a learner. The file reads as if two batches translated it, because several core terms change partway through. Up to [18] it uses 이징 모델 / 시간 전개 / 트로터 / 잡음 / 잡 / Transpile. From [36] on it switches to Ising 모형 / 시간 발전 / Trotter / 노이즈 / 작업 / 트랜스파일. There are also a few stiff spots: the doubled 시간 in '전체 시간 발전 시간' ([36]) and a humble 보여 드립니다 ([38]). The whole page is in 합니다체 rather than the requested 해요체; this is consistent, so it is a minor note at most.

examples.source: Trotter approximation error and hardware noise
examples.translation: 트로터 근사 오차와 하드웨어 잡음
examples.suggested: Trotter 근사 오차와 하드웨어 노이즈 (or keep 트로터/잡음 and use them everywhere)
examples.why: Up to [18] the file uses 트로터 and 잡음, but from [36] on it uses Trotter and 노이즈 (e.g. [63], [67]). Pick one form for each term.

examples.source: described by the transverse-field Ising model above ... The total evolution time is
examples.translation: 횡자기장 Ising 모형으로 기술되는 ... 전체 시간 발전 시간은
examples.suggested: 횡자기장 이징 모델로 기술되는 ... 전체 시간 전개 길이는 (or 전체 발전 시간은)
examples.why: Earlier entries ([0], [1], [10], [15]) use 이징 모델 and 시간 전개. This entry switches to Ising 모형 and 시간 발전, and the doubled 시간 reads awkwardly.

examples.source: the circuits must first be transpiled
examples.translation: 먼저 회로를 트랜스파일해야 합니다
examples.suggested: Use either 트랜스파일 or Transpile throughout
examples.why: [5], [11] and [14] write 'Transpile' in Latin script, while [49]-[53] write 트랜스파일. The term is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: as `Sampler` jobs
examples.translation: `Sampler` 작업으로
examples.suggested: `Sampler` 잡으로 (to match [13], [14])
examples.why: 'job' is 잡 in [13] and [14] but 작업 in [53] and [54].

examples.source: we first demonstrate the classical simulation workflow
examples.translation: 고전 시뮬레이션 워크플로를 보여 드립니다
examples.suggested: 고전 시뮬레이션 워크플로를 보여 줍니다
examples.why: The humble form 드리- is a formal-register slip. The other entries use 보여 줍니다.
